trailhead.label: Aschbach cable car top station (official start and end)

waypoints.label: Drinking fountain by the cable car station

cautions: Forest tracks and paths with some roots and stones.
Short stretches on the Aschbach village road at the start.
Hunting stands and a game-feeding place by the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
